title: SmartRecruiters integration (ATS & HRMS) | Xobin
text:
About SmartRecruiters
SmartRecruiters is a cloud-based talent acquisition suite that helps organisations attract, evaluate and hire top talent efficiently. It offers end-to-end recruitment capability including job posting, candidate management, collaborative hiring and workflow automation, enabling teams to improve hiring outcomes at scale.
Why Integrate SmartRecruiters with Xobin?
Integrating SmartRecruiters with Xobin brings skill-based assessments directly into your hiring workflow. Recruiters can invite candidates to assessments, automate test delivery at different hiring stages and view detailed performance reports without leaving SmartRecruiters. This reduces manual effort, improves hiring speed and ensures objective, data-backed candidate evaluation.
Steps to Integrate SmartRecruiters with Xobin
Setting up the integration
Log in to your Xobin account.
Navigate to
Settings > Integrations
, search for
SmartRecruiters
and click
Connect
Click
Open SmartRecruiters
to continue.
In SmartRecruiters, search for
Xobin
and open the Xobin app.
and review the required permissions.
Allow and Continue
to approve access.
You are redirected to the Xobin sign-in page. Log in to your account.
Review the requested scopes and permissions, then click
Allow Access
Once approved you are redirected back to SmartRecruiters, confirming successful integration.
Inviting candidates to an assessment
Method 1: Send an assessment from a job (manual)
Go to
Jobs
and open the relevant job.
Select a candidate and open their profile.
Scroll to the
Assessments
section and click
Order Assessments
Choose the assessment, confirm and click
Send
Method 2: Inline assessment during job application
Settings > Configuration > Hiring Process
Select the hiring process and click
Manage Inline Assessments
Activate the required Xobin assessment.
When a candidate applies via the careers page they are redirected to the assessment automatically and returned to the application flow afterwards.
Method 3: Assessment via a hiring process step
Settings > Hiring Process
and add a new step called
Skill Test
Configure the step to use a Xobin assessment.
Enable
Auto Trigger
to send assessments automatically when candidates reach this step.
Move candidates to the Skill Test stage to trigger, or send the test manually.
Viewing assessment results
Open the job and select the assessed candidate.
Under
, view the completion status and score.
View Attachment
to access Xobin's detailed report including skill analysis and performance insight.
Who is this integration for?
This integration is ideal for recruiters, HR managers, talent acquisition leaders and hiring managers using SmartRecruiters. It is especially useful for fast-growing companies, enterprises and teams hiring at scale who want to automate candidate screening, improve assessment accuracy and make faster, unbiased hiring decisions across technical and non-technical roles.
Capabilities
Features & benefits
OAuth-style connection
Connect from Xobin, approve the Xobin app in SmartRecruiters and grant scopes, no API keys to copy.
Order assessments manually
Open a candidate on any job, scroll to Assessments and use Order Assessments to send a test on demand.
Inline assessments on apply
Activate an inline assessment on the hiring process so applicants take the test as part of the careers-site application.
Auto-triggered Skill Test stage
Add a Skill Test step with Auto Trigger enabled and assessments go out the moment candidates reach that stage.
Assess at apply or later
Run an inline assessment during the careers-site application, or order one manually further down the process.
Scoped, revocable access
The Xobin app requests only the permissions it needs and can be disconnected from SmartRecruiters at any time.
